presets.label: Planck 2018 · ΛCDM reference
presets.notes: TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing marginalized means. Matter split preserves rounded Ωm=0.3153; neutrino residual is treated as pressureless today and into the future. Radiation contains photons and an effective two massless species; no massive-neutrino radiation double counting. Closure determines Ωde. This is a reference, not a claim of a unique current best fit. The neutrino fraction is the residual of rounded matter and cold+baryon means, not an exact mass-to-density conversion.

presets.label: DESI 2026 + CMB + SNe · CPL
presets.notes: DR2 BAO + Lyα full shape + CMB + DES-Dovekie Table 3 marginalized means. Baryon/neutrino split and radiation are reference approximations, not extracted joint fit parameters. CPL is a fit ansatz and is not a reliable infinite-future extrapolation. No joint covariance supplied in this dataset.

presets.label: P-ACT H₀ · illustrative composition
presets.notes: H0 is P-ACT alone, 67.62 ± 0.50. Density composition is a declared illustrative reference, not the ACT best-fit parameter vector. P-ACT+lensing+DESI DR2 gives H0=68.43 ± 0.27 under flat ΛCDM. The Ωm sampling width 0.0073 is illustrative, borrowed from the Planck reference, not measured by this combination.

covarianceNote: Marginal errors are not a joint posterior. Default ensembles use explicitly labeled independent illustrative Gaussians; users can supply a positive-definite covariance or posterior samples.
updatePolicy: Review primary sources, record combination and table, validate units and closure, increment version, retain previous release in Git. Never auto-replace defaults from headlines.
